title.heading: MouseVader
title.sub: Pollute the tracking data, not your browsing

scenes.text: Many websites record where your mouse goes: what you hover over, and for how long. That trail says a lot about your interests.
MouseVader adds noise to it. While you browse, it makes fake pointer visits to random parts of the page, and trackers record them right alongside your real ones.
It stays out of your way. When you use the mouse yourself, it pauses, so it never closes a menu you opened.
The toolbar button shows how much noise it has added, and lets you switch it off for this site, or everywhere.
Off on this site means no fake activity here at all. Switch it back on, and choose how much noise you want: slow, normal or fast.
In settings, keep a list of sites to leave alone, and choose how long to pause after you use the page.
MouseVader for Firefox. Free and open source. It collects nothing, and sends nothing.
